hypothesis: BF and XSS are confused primarily with each other, not broadly with other classes. A binary specialist trained only on BF/XSS rows using the full 68-feature set can separate them more sharply than the 15-way primary model, without affecting any other class because it is only consulted when the primary model itself predicted BF or XSS.
changed_vs_current_baseline: Added a second-stage binary specialist for BF vs XSS.
Added cascade routing logic at inference time (validation only; test set untouched).
unchanged_vs_current_baseline: Primary model architecture and all hyperparameters
routing_rule: A validation row is re-decided by the specialist if and only if the primary model's own argmax prediction for that row is 'Web Attack - Brute Force' or 'Web Attack - XSS'. All other rows are left unchanged.

guardrail.description: Per-class F1 for every class other than BF/XSS must be identical before and after the cascade, since the routing rule cannot touch predictions outside the two targeted classes.
